title: Kaadhal Parisu
desc: Sisters Malini and Chitra are heirs to a huge fortune. Chitra is in for a shock when she introduces her boyfriend to Malini and the latter accuses him of raping her years ago.

title: Taj Mahal
desc: Maayan falls in love with Machakanni, a woman whose engagement was recently called off. However, a rivalry between their respective villages threatens their relationship.

title: Gopurangal Saivathillai
desc: A sales professional is forced to marry a girl of his father's choice and is shocked by her appearance. He later relocates and marries his colleague which leads to a chain of events.

title: Veera Thalattu
desc: Pandi, a villager, loves his mother beyond words. However, Pandi gets shocked when his uncle reveals that she is not the one who gave birth to him.

title: Maayi
desc: Maayi is a charitable man who respects all women and does not tolerate injustice. Soon, he brings his struggling step-sister home to live in comfort after their father commits suicide.
